Polling data reveals deep partisan and generational splits—young adults lean positive, while voters reject the broad label yet support economic intervention.

Plane Error: Q1 (WHO) vs Q3 (WHAT).
The report substitutes partisan campaign talking points for comprehensive empirical analysis of public opinion.

Actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by manufacturing an existential socialist threat to capture voter anxiety, bypassing transparent economic debate.

Actual Article Body:
More voters are becoming leery of socialism, as Republicans have worked to paint the system in a negative light ahead of the midterm elections, according to a new poll.

President Donald Trump and other top GOP figures have warned throughout the election cycle that socialists are gaining increasing power in the Democratic Party, a development they say could “tear down the American system.” The 2026 elections are “different,” House Majority Leader Mike Johnson (R-LA) alerted on Friday, arguing that the rising socialist movement could “end the free market system” if Democrats sweep the elections Tuesday.
